title: Memories from Members of UTT/68th Aviation Company
citation: Memories from Members of UTT/68th Aviation Company, source unknown, book excerpts, 97 pp. Richard (Dick) Detra Collection, association 188th Assault Helicopter Company Association, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University, item 0690505003.
notes: First-person chapters by members of the Utility Tactical Transport (UTT) Helicopter Company / 68th Aviation Company, covering 1963-65 in III Corps. Describes an area of operations centred on Tay Ninh and repeated armed-helicopter support to Special Forces around Nui Ba Den. Its chapter on the battle of Dong Xoai, 9 June 1965, records the radio call sign of the Special Forces officer in the camp as '55 Body Jab' - the first period source found for the call word Larry remembers as 'Body Jab 42', and corroboration of his account that Special Forces call signs in his area were boxing terms.
